channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Ralph Waldo Emerson — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “Bad times have a scientific value. These are occasions a good learner would not miss.” — Ralph Waldo Emerson

item.title: J.R.R. Tolkien — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “Not all those who wander are lost.” — J.R.R. Tolkien

item.title: Cicero — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “Not for ourselves alone are we born.” — Cicero

item.title: Mansur al-Hallaj — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “Kill me, O my faithful friends, for in my death is my life.” — Mansur al-Hallaj

item.title: Germaine de Stael — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-28
item.description: “Wit lies in recognizing the resemblance among things which differ and the difference between things which are alike.” — Germaine de Stael

item.title: Rudyard Kipling — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-27
item.description: “For the strength of the Pack is the Wolf, and the strength of the Wolf is the Pack.” — Rudyard Kipling

item.title: Sophocles — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-26
item.description: “I would prefer even to fail with honor than win by cheating.” — Sophocles

item.title: Rumi — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-25
item.description: “Lovers don't finally meet somewhere. They're in each other all along.” — Rumi
